描述_EN: the medallion, in natural wool, orange-brown, wine lees and pink, is divided into four parts and a central motif. One of the two parallel bands features red and green interlacing; the other a series of orange-brown squares and wine lees. the band forming a right angle is adorned with geometric motifs. Rectangular canvas fragment with four polychrome looped decorative elements: two parallel bands at each end, a medallion and a band forming a right angle. One end of the piece is crossed by four woollen threads, two green in the center and two red on either side.
描述_ZN: 奖章，以天然羊毛、橙褐色、酒糟和粉红色为主，分为四个部分和一个中心图案。 两条平行带中的一条描绘了红色和绿色的交错设计；另一条是一系列橙色和酒褐色的方块。 形成直角的带子上装饰着几何图案。 长方形帆布碎片，有四个多色环状装饰元素：两端的两个平行带，一个奖章和一个形成直角的带子。 作品的一端由四根毛线交叉，中间两根绿色，两侧两根红色。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
